subject.title: fix(ui): keep agent selection aligned across session switches

question: Should the release support upgraded clients connected to an older Gateway by safely handling ownerless default-agent global digests, or is a coordinated Gateway-first upgrade requirement acceptable?
rationale: The schema deliberately makes agentId optional, but the new native-client projection rejects ownerless canonical-global digests; choosing between compatibility behavior and a coordinated-upgrade contract requires maintainer ownership of the release boundary.

options.title: Preserve mixed-version status
options.body: Recommended: infer only the negotiated default-agent global owner for an ownerless legacy digest, retain fail-closed behavior for ambiguous non-default ownership, and add upgrade coverage.

options.title: Require coordinated upgrades
options.body: Document that client and Gateway versions must be upgraded together and accept that an updated client may temporarily omit global observer status against an older Gateway.

recommendation.title: Preserve mixed-version status
recommendation.body: Recommended: infer only the negotiated default-agent global owner for an ownerless legacy digest, retain fail-closed behavior for ambiguous non-default ownership, and add upgrade coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor carried the cross-platform ownership design and is the strongest available routing candidate for the rollout contract.
